permits.description: convert rear detached studio space to (n) garage at rear of building and extend and renovate rear deck.
new 8'6 tall auto gate at existing automobile gate location
interior kitchen and bathroom remodel in upper unti #1 only. includeds plumbing and electrical work.

convert (e) closet into laundry room - no structural, no moving walls, door opening to remain same size, add fan in laundry room & bathroom. louvered door, dryer vent per cmc 504.4 maintain rated separation between units. or 100sq in make-up air opening.
install wood cedar siding to back wall & right rear wall, no structural changes, 2000 sq. ft.
replacement of (2) windows & a door to window conversion. (2) are rear facing. (1) on roof - street facing but not visible

one unit: construct new hall half bathroom - install toilet-pedestal sink & light above. new waste & supply line for sink and toilet. new exhaust fan with roof jack. build 2 new perimeter walls. install non-dedicated circuirs & gfci outlet.
one unit: hall bathroom alteration - remove (e) shower enclosure. install new shower pan & wall surround. vanity. toilet, exhaust fan. ded ckt & gfci outlet. vacancy sensor and switch for fan.
one unit: kitchen remodeling: plmbing water line for firdge, move gas line, electrical upgrade, new appliances. led lighting. like for like no walls removal, relocate or addition.
3rd floor: remodel bath #1. add new leo light. add new tub. relocate dryer and washer. new tile floor and hardwood floor. new shower tile. work on 3rd floor only.
remodel 1st floor apartment. kitchen, 2 baths, laundry room, new windows/doors. remove walls at rear of apt and install new stuctural. remove (e) shed and porch at rear and install new deck at grade.
admdinistrative permit. to document that 2123 bust street is a two-residential unit building. see p.a. 8603897.
